basic_info.description: Located in Forest Knolls this 2,543+/- square foot single-family home commands a bright corner lot location. Built in 1979, the residence offers 4-bedrooms, 2 full baths, plus 2 half baths across three elevator-connected levels. The main floor features a modern kitchen with new stainless appliances and a breakfast bar flowing into the dining area with new modern drum chandelier. The sunken living room showcases limestone flooring with radiant heat, a gas fireplace, and a library nook. Expansive south and west-facing windows flood the space with sunlight, while sliding doors open to a Trex deck. A family room provides additional living space. Upstairs, find three bedrooms including a primary suite with walk-in closet and spacious ensuite bath featuring a double vanity, glass-enclosed shower, and soaking tub. Two additional bedrooms offer peaked ceilings and share a full bath. The garden/garage level includes a two-car garage with built-in storage and laundry area. A fourth bedroom with half bath opens to a rear yard with hot tub and room for a garden. Situated on Mount Sutro's southwestern slope, Forest Knolls offers a tranquil retreat minutes from UCSF campus, Golden Gate Park, and West Portal, with easy access to San Francisco's vibrant shopping and coveted natural green space.
